description: A talk of two turns: in turn 1 he says his son Luke is 14 and they read Greek together on Sundays; in turn 2, with no history sent, he asks what he told the tutor about his son, and the resumed session answers from turn 1 with the name and the age.

request.greek: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν θεὸν πάντα συνεργεῖ εἰς ἀγαθόν τοῖς κατὰ πρόθεσιν κλητοῖς οὖσιν
request.english: And we know that all things work together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
request.question: Before we start: my son Luke is 14 and we read Greek together on Sundays. What does ἀγαπῶσιν mean here?

request.greek: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν θεὸν πάντα συνεργεῖ εἰς ἀγαθόν τοῖς κατὰ πρόθεσιν κλητοῖς οὖσιν
request.english: And we know that all things work together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
request.question: What did I tell you about my son?
